about_the_game:
Demo Experience

Get a taste of Rift Shaper’s geokinetic combat! The demo focuses on teaching you the core mechanics and letting you experiment with them and the melee system. There's also a Combat Gallery built to test your new powers. Score points by using your gauntlets and powers to move obstacles and smash targets against the clock.

Geokinetic Combat

Bring out the power of the earth with your own movement. Each ability is triggered by striking precise stances inspired by real-life combat.

Equip stone-forged gauntlets to crush, grab, and hurl your enemies directly. Intense battles with adjustable difficulty will let you break a sweat, move with purpose, and feel the adrenaline of every strike.

The ground itself is bursting alive with energy waiting to be unleashed. Use it to raise stalagmites and block attacks, pull walls to use as shields, or smash through them to create new or uncover hidden paths.

Key Features

  • Pose-based abilities: Trigger geokinetic powers through intentional stances and gestures. Your body is the controller.

  • Destructible environments:  Raise, break, and reshape the terrain in real time.

  • Testing Gallery: A mini-game that will let you test your powers.

Join the Community and help shape the Rift!

Share your ideas for new powers, enemies, and mechanics, report bugs, or discuss strategies with other explorers. Your feedback will directly influence development as the Rift continues to grow.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Core i5-4590 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • VR Support: Open XR, requires motion controllers
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 6700 or greater
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 or greater
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • VR Support: Open XR, requires motion controllers

short_description: Rift Shaper is a VR roguelite where you shape the battlefield itself with your own hands. Raise pillars and hurl boulders in intense melee battles that test skill and stamina. Punch, throw, and crush stone creatures using gesture-based combat and feel the true power of controlling the earth itself.
supported_languages: Spanish - Spain, Spanish - Latin America, English, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
